accessibility: The findings are a tree named "Findings by problem, resource and Widget" in the real page; each finding is a button that names what it opens. Severity is carried by its word and its ink, never by color alone.
The group and filter controls keep their names (Group by, Source, Category, Severity, View, Variant) as accessible names.
constraints: Built only from Adapter Widgets (Rail, NavItem, Button, Stack, Text, Icon, Alert, EmptyState, SegmentedControl, Segment, TabBar and TabBarItem); no Widget outside the Adapter catalog. The shell is the one of the Overview View.

The tree is Stack rows indented by level, always expanded: the Adapter has no tree Widget; the real tree expands and collapses each group. The group-by and filter controls are buttons that show the value in effect, the real ones are selects.

Each grouping is its own tree and a Variant shows one of them; a filter is the same, because a Widget cannot filter its own children. The strings of the app are copied under the same Locale keys; parameters are the Widget values.
Visual language follows the Quiet Canvas design system in DESIGN.md.
entryConditions: A member opened Overview › Checks after a run that listed findings; the Checks tab carries the number of findings. The sources and the run state are in Overview: Checks.

The base state groups six findings by problem: a Variant that overrides state a Widget does not have, a blank translation, a Catalog entry that has no matching Widget and a Product Kit component that declares neither props nor emits. Variants regroup, filter and add the Preview's own findings.

The render context selects one Workspace viewport preset, one Locale and one theme; the Workbench chrome follows the Workbench language, so its text is baked here per Locale. Names, Widget ids, Variants and counts are sample content.
spec.intent: Show the findings a finished Run Checks lists, as built from Adapter Widgets only: grouped by problem, then resource, then Widget, each finding with its origin, scope, state and severity, and the grouping and filters that let a person narrow them.
interactionRules: Findings are grouped by problem by default and can be grouped by source, severity or View; a group lists its resources and each resource its findings, and every level says how many it holds.

Each finding keeps its origin, scope, state and severity on its own line (Error or Warning, source, resource kind, Variant, Completed); sources are never merged into one warning type, and the severity follows from the source, not from the data: structure and schema findings, Catalog problems and runtime errors are errors, translation reminders and Preview translation warnings are warnings.

The findings are filtered by source, category, severity, View and, once any finding names one, Variant; a finding of a Variant of a View is attributed to that Variant. A filter that matches nothing says so and offers Clear filters.

A Widget finding opens its View on the Inspector with the Widget selected, a translation reminder opens its cell in the translation table, and a finding of the Workspace settings, a Flow, an Asset or the Product Kit opens that page; a finding whose View no longer exists opens nothing and says so in a notice, so the person stays on Checks.
Catalog problems are listed only for entries a View uses and count the Views and Widgets; the Preview's translation warnings are grouped by warning code first.
